question: In which year the Article 35A was added to the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1954.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Article 35A **of the **Indian Constitution **was an article that empowered the **Jammu and Kashmir **state's **legislature **to define **"permanent residents**" of the **state **and **provide special rights **and **privileges to them**.
 
• It was **added **to the Constitution </strong
